data: What is the model's accuracy when using the 'Swapping' strategy with an edit distance of 30?

The question asks for the model's accuracy when using the 'Swapping' strategy with an edit distance of 30. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the maximum edit distance difference, and the y-axis represents the model accuracy. The blue line in the graph corresponds to the 'Swapping' strategy. At an edit distance of 30, the blue line intersects the y-axis at approximately 40%. Therefore, the model's accuracy when using the 'Swapping' strategy with an edit distance of 30 is around 40%.
